transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm... well, I've been hearing things lately. For about eight months now, I keep hearing voices when no one is actually there, and I feel like I'm constantly being watched and monitored by people.
Alongside these experiences with the voices and feeling watched, have you noticed any significant changes in your mood, like feeling very depressed or unusually high and energized?

Yes, I've been feeling really down and depressed for about the last five months. I've lost interest in everything, have no motivation, and struggle a lot with sleeping. But I've never had any times where I felt unusually high, hyper, or energized.

You mentioned the voices and feeling watched started eight months ago, but the depression started five months ago. During those first three months, before you felt depressed, were you still hearing the voices and feeling watched?

Yes, I was. During those first three months before the depression started, I was already hearing the voices and constantly feeling like I was being watched. Those scary experiences definitely came first, and then the deep sadness and lack of energy only set in about five months ago.

No, I don't drink alcohol or use any recreational drugs. I've never really used substances like that.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or did you start taking any new prescription medications around the time these symptoms began eight months ago?
No, I don't have any diagnosed medical conditions. I also didn't start taking any new prescription medications when all of this started.

Yes, I've been feeling deeply depressed for the past five months. I have completely lost interest in things I used to enjoy, feel extremely unmotivated, and really struggle to concentrate on anything. My sleep is also terrible—I have a hard time falling asleep and always wake up feeling completely unrefreshed.
During these past five months of feeling depressed, have you also experienced feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or any thoughts of death or suicide?

Yes, over the past five months, I've had thoughts of wanting to die and sometimes wish I wouldn't wake up, though I don't have any specific plans or impulses. I don't really experience strong feelings of guilt or worthlessness, but I just feel so down and want it all to end.
